review_loop.skill: /review-2 (two parallel read-only reviewers: bug-hunting debugger; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor) → /address
review_loop.verdict_before_addressing: Request Changes — 4 criticals after dedup (the button-path trio corroborated by both reviewers: NSRange attribute misuse in selected_text; the hub calling tfRunNoteTransform with wrong arity and no definition picker; whole-note accept inserting at the caret instead of replacing; restore never rebinding the editor — all in the AppKit binding layer the headless tests bypass), 13 warnings, ~14 suggestions
review_loop.addressed: All four criticals fixed with regression tests driven through the production paths (the picker + button action; whole-note range (0, len) coerced at the coordinator too; the refresh rebinds whenever the persisted revision moves under a clean editor). Every warning fixed: select/reload share one loader generation (the just-created note actually appears); tab close rebinds or clears the editor and switching notes flushes the outgoing buffer; a no-change flush clears the tail-risk marker; scratchpad_receive enforces the PTT-time note binding and delivers at the captured anchor; hubSaveHistoryRow falls back applied→cleaned→raw; the revision_count column misalignment; the versions list bounded at 200 with an honest truncated flag (storage growth documented as a limitation — coalescing would violate the append-only contract here). Suggestions applied: the shared _conn_append_revision/_conn_latest helpers replace the duplicated envelope SQL; stale evidence links close as example_unavailable; closed stores fail fast instead of hanging; notes_meta and editor_origin (dead schema/state) cut; attachment insert-failure unlink; marker alt-text sanitizing; slugged export names; export flushes the debounce tail; partial-export cleanup; pending attribution restored on flush failure; transform_note task kind; objc.python_method decorators. Deferred with reasons: mid-word span placement stays a documented heuristic; two arrivals in one debounce window merge under the second origin (sub-second window, both texts persist). No findings rejected as incorrect.
review_loop.post_address: All 44 fast suites, all six model-backed checks, the V1 control (51/51) and the benchmark re-ran green on the fixed code. The /review-2 stale-callback hang (a deferred Hub refresh executing against a closed harness's store) was root-caused to the test harness and closed with the harness-side discard_pending plus the store's fail-fast guard.
